messages:
Maya - People Ops: Quick drop 60s manager kit for the upcoming review window. Aim: paste into DM, team channel, or 1:1 agenda.

Maya - People Ops: Core ask to ICs: 3 bullets: Wins, Per-goal metric, One growth ask + any blockers. Keep each goal summary to one sentence.

Maya - People Ops: Pasteable manager DM:
`Hey {{name}}, self-reviews open Apr 1-14. Reply with: 1) 3 wins (bullets) 2) For each goal: one metric/signal + one example link 3) One growth area + how I can help 4) Any blockers`

Jon - Eng Manager: Love the links requirement 10x easier for calibration. Can we add a 1-line manager calibration template?

Maya - People Ops: Yes: `Calibration one-liner: {impact signal}, {consistency}, {craft/ownership}` e.g. "Launched X (usage +15%), consistently met SLAs, strong ownership"

Elena - Design Manager: Also recommend asking for up to 3 artifacts (PRs, Figma files, notes). It saves time.

Maya - People Ops: Added note: "Include up to 3 artifact links (optional but highly recommended)."

sre-bot: Reminder: review window Apr 1-14. Office hours Apr 9 10:00 PT.

Jon - Eng Manager: I'll paste this into my team channel and run a 20-min drop-in for anyone needing help.

Maya - People Ops: One more operational rule: late submissions accepted within 48 hours with manager note. After that, escalate to People Ops.

Elena - Design Manager: Perfect. Can you make a one-page with examples for different roles (IC, Senior, Lead)?

Maya - People Ops: Will do 1 will post in People Ops channel and pin it. If you want an editable copy, DM me. :sparkles:
